title: Caller-declared Rust checks
description: The parsed shape of the optional .github/ci.toml document.

wasm_crates.description: Exact caller Cargo package names, in execution order. Repetitions are retained.

check_targets.description: Exact caller compiler targets with a supported native runner, in execution order.

test_tools.description: Install caller mise.toml tools and expose their binaries to isolated tests.

browser_build.description: Run the caller's mise-pinned just browser-build after the listed wasm builds.

coverage_min_lines.description: Required line coverage percentage; callers may only raise the 80% floor.

spelling_words.description: Additional accepted spelling words; tool defaults remain active.

git_sources.description: Exact HTTPS git repository URLs permitted in addition to crates.io.

license_exceptions.description: Additional accepted licenses for an exact package version.

privileged_trigger_workflows.description: Exact existing caller workflow paths; ignore only dangerous-triggers for these files. No globs, parent components, colons or backslashes.
